## Teaching Plan {#teaching-plan}

**Engineering Mechanics: Statics**

| Week | Topic | Main focus |
|:----:|:------|:-----------|
| 1 | Static equilibrium of rigid bodies | Free-body diagrams, equilibrium equations, and solving for unknown forces and moments |
| 2 | Analysis of structures: frames, machines, beams and cables | Determining internal and external forces in common engineering structures |
| 3 | Friction | Dry friction and its application to practical engineering systems |
| 4 | Additional topics | Instructor-led topics, student-led review of key projects |

: {.striped .hover tbl-colwidths="[8,30,62]"}

## Data Resources {#data-resources}

Specific data sources to be used during the course.

### Support reactions and free-body diagrams

- [**Engineering Statics: Free-Body Diagrams**](https://engineeringstatics.org/Chapter_05-free-body-diagrams.html){target="_blank"}: reactions from 2D and 3D supports.

### Centroids and moment of inertia (area)

- [**MechanicsMap (Penn State): Centroids, 2D**](https://mechanicsmap.psu.edu/websites/centroidtables/centroids2D/centroids2D.html){target="_blank"}: centroid and area moment of inertia tables for 2D shapes.
- [**MechanicsMap (Penn State): Centroids, 3D**](https://mechanicsmap.psu.edu/websites/centroidtables/centroids3D/centroids3D.html){target="_blank"}: centroid and area moment of inertia tables for 3D shapes.

## Recommended Books {#recommended-books}

::: {.callout-note}
Any textbook prescribed by your institute is suitable. The books below are additional references that students may find useful.
:::

| Book title | Author(s) | Publisher | Edition / availability |
|:-----------|:----------|:----------|:-----------------------|
| Engineering Mechanics: Vector and Classical Approach | S. S. Bhavikatti | New Age International Publishers | Indian edition |
| A Textbook of Engineering Mechanics | R. K. Bansal and Sanjay Bansal | Laxmi Publications | Indian edition |
| A Textbook of Engineering Mechanics | R. S. Khurmi and N. Khurmi | S. Chand Publishing | Indian edition |
| Engineering Mechanics: Statics & Dynamics | Russell C. Hibbeler | Pearson Education | International author; Indian/SI edition available |
| Engineering Mechanics | S. Timoshenko, D. H. Young, J. V. Rao, and Sukumar Pati | McGraw Hill Education | Check the edition available locally |
| Vector Mechanics for Engineers: Statics and Dynamics | Ferdinand P. Beer, E. Russell Johnston, David Mazurek, Phillip J. Cornwell, and Brian Self | McGraw Hill Education (India) | Indian edition available |

: {.striped .hover tbl-colwidths="[28,32,18,22]"}
